questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Installing Arduino Core and ESP-IDF”?
options: Pin selection must be checked against the exact module and board schematic.
ESP-IDF selects the chip target before building.
The ESP32 name alone does not guarantee pin or radio compatibility; check the exact part.

questions.answer: ESP-IDF selects the chip target before building.
questions.explanation:
ESP-IDF selects the chip target before building.
Why: Arduino-ESP32 offers the familiar sketch model. ESP-IDF is Espressif's component-based CMake/Kconfig and FreeRTOS framework; choose for project needs and pin the version.

`idf.py` commands are specific to an ESP-IDF project and toolchain. Arduino-ESP32 uses its own Arduino CLI/IDE board package and build workflow; these commands are not Arduino sketch commands.
